physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Coma Cluster is recorded: it is an extended cluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 1737100 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

(2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, tables 2 (group membership, 1PGC) and 3 (group distance modulus, DMzp), as joined into the Nearby Universe's tracked table (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94); catalogue reference cosmicflows-4:44715: 95104266.41573906 pc; Cosmicflows-4 group distance: the weighted average of its members' distance moduli on the calibrated scale (table 3, DMzp).
